text: . In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold lost 0.6 per cent to 1,34,201 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, silver also dropped 0.6 per cent to 1,69,171 rupees per kilogram according to the closing rates of India Bullion and Jewellers Association.

. The nationwide ‘Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad: Know Your Vote’ campaign has concluded with 536 Yuva Samvads conducted across 31 States and Union Territories. The campaign organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports through Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) reached over one lakh young people and involved more than 5000 Youth Icons. The campaign brought discussions on electoral awareness to colleges and educational institutions across the country. It encouraged young people, particularly first-time voters, to understand their voting rights and electoral procedures and participate responsibly in democracy.The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports said that the campaign witnessed participation by Governors, Union Ministers, State Ministers, Members of Parliament and other public representatives. It added that sports personalities and youth icons from the sporting community also participated in programmes, sharing their experiences and encouraging youth participation in sports.The Yuva Samvads provided young participants with opportunities to seek clarity on electoral procedures, discuss voting rights and civic responsibilities, and interact directly with public representatives and Youth Icons.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices rose for the second consecutive session today. The Sensex gained 427 points or 0.52 per cent, to close at 82,532. The Nifty advanced 96 points or 0.38 per cent, to settle at 25,387.The broader market on the National Stock Exchange witnessed a mixed trend, with the Nifty Midcap 100 index rising a quarter of a per cent, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 index declined 0.2 per cent.In the Sensex pack, 18 out of 30 constituent companies logged gains. Among the top performers, Axis Bank surged 2.1 per cent, Reliance gained two per cent, and SBI as well as TCS rose 1.7 per cent. In contrast, HCL Tech dropped nearly two per cent, PowerGrid lost 1.5 per cent, and Tech Mahindra fell 1.4 per cent.In the sectoral indices on the BSE, 20 out of 28 sectors edged upward. Among the top gainers, PSU Banks surged 2.1 per cent, Realty rose 1.9 per cent and Mid-Small Private Banks gained 1.4 per cent. In contrast, Telecommunication shed 1.6 per cent, Capital Goods lost 1.1 per cent, and Insurance fell 0.9 per cent.The overall market breadth at the BSE was negative, as shares of 2,281 companies declined, 2,151 advanced and 224 remained unchanged.

. Minister of State for Defence, Sanjay Seth, today arrived in Brussels to attend the Schuman Security and Defence Forum. In a social media post, Mr Seth said that on his arrival, he was received by the Ambassador of India to Belgium and the European Union, Pranay Verma. He added that the visit underscores India’s growing defence and strategic cooperation with the European Union following the signing of the India-European Union Strategic and Defence Partnership Agreement in January this year.

. Home Minister Amit Shah today paid tributes to revolutionary freedom fighter Batukeshwar Dutt on his birth anniversary. In a social media post, Mr Shah said that Batukeshwar Dutt’s name is remembered with pride whenever courage, bravery and determination in India’s freedom struggle are discussed. He said that through the Hindustan Socialist Republican Association, Batukeshwar Dutt organised revolutionaries and inspired them toward an armed struggle.Alongside Bhagat Singh, he struck terror into the heart of the British colonial regime by his actions in the Central Assembly, conveying the clear message that India belongs solely to its people. Mr Shah said that even the hardships of Cellular Jail could not weaken his resolve, and he consistently raised his voice against the injustices faced by Indian freedom fighters in prison.

. External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar has said that in the current geopolitical climate, both India and Japan recognise the imperative of building resilient and reliable global supply chains in key sectors. Dr Jaishankar stated this in his video message for the 9th India-Japan Indo-Pacific Forum, which concluded yesterday in New Delhi. He said, defence and security cooperation, economic security, energy resilience, technology and innovation, and greater people-to-people connectivity will continue to be the focus areas under the Special Strategic and Global Partnership.The External Affairs Minister observed that India and Japan’s Special Strategic and Global Partnership is anchored in trust and goodwill and linked by a common strategic outlook. He said, it contributes to peace, stability and economic prosperity, not just for these two nations but for the world at large. Dr Jaishankar said that as two major Asian democracies, dynamic market economies and maritime nations, India and Japan are indispensable to shaping a free, open and rules-based Indo-Pacific. He said, Japan is an important FDI partner for India and contributes to India’s vision of a Viksit and Atmanirbhar Bharat. He said, in turn, India’s stable economic growth provides Japanese businesses with an opportunity to make in India and make for the world.

. In badminton, India’s Lakshya Sen clinched the men’s singles title at the Kumamoto Masters Japan, defeating Japan’s Koki Watanabe in a thrilling three-game final this morning.Lakshya fought back from a game down to win 13-21, 21-18, 21-14 in one hour and four minutes. With this victory, he became the first Indian shuttler to win the tournament since its inception in 2023.This was Lakshya’s second consecutive BWF Super 500 title, following his triumph at the Hylo Open in Germany earlier this month. It was also his sixth BWF World Tour title and the first time he has won two Tour titles in a single season.The victory earned him 9,200 ranking points, boosting his chances of qualifying for the 2026 BWF World Tour Finals in Hangzhou.

. The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports has constituted a 14-member Committee to build a sustainable sports league ecosystem in India. The Ministry said that a robust league structure is envisaged to provide regular, high-quality competitive pathways for talent identification and athlete development. It will simultaneously drive private investment and generate employment across sports management, broadcasting, technology, events, and allied services. Joint Secretary (Governance) Kunal will be the convenor of this committee, while other members include Joint Secretary, Khelo India, Vineel Krishna and CEO of Indian Olympic Association, Raghuram Iyer. Our correspondent reports that committee will conduct its deliberations in physical, online, or hybrid modes and submit its final recommendations to the Ministry within eight weeks.The Committee will examine the existing sports league ecosystem in India to assess the varying degrees of success achieved by different leagues and identify the key challenges faced by sports disciplines. It will identify priority sports and categories, particularly Olympic sports, women’s sports, youth sports, indigenous sports, and emerging sports, to recommend suitable operational models tailored to their sporting and commercial potential.The Committee will also examine mechanisms for structured Government facilitation alongside active participation from the private sector, sports organisations, State Governments, local bodies, and communities. The Committee has been mandated to assess existing ecosystem constraints, identify priority sports, and recommend measures to attract corporate capital, franchise ownership, sponsorships, broadcasting and digital rights and Corporate Social Responsibility financing.

. A vessel belonging to the logistics arm of UAE’s national oil company was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday evening.ADNOC Logistics and Services infomred that one crew member remains unaccounted for, with search and rescue operations being carried out in coordination with the relevant authorities. All the other crew members have been evacuated safely from the vessel, with 11 of them sustaining injuries.Our immediate priority is supporting the search and rescue effort, our crew and those affected,” ADNOC L&S said in a statement, quoted by the Emirates News Agency (WAM). ADNOC reiterated the importance of protecting seafarers and safeguarding freedom of navigation and maritime security.ADNOC Logistics and Services is the maritime logistics arm of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) that provides shipping, integrated logistics and marine services to the energy industry. Last week, the company had reported damage to one of its vessels in an attack in UAE’s territorial waters. Last few days have seen an increase in reported threats to ships transiting the strategic waterway, while Iran has often blamed ship operators for hitting sea mines.

. India’s electronic goods exports registered strong growth of 44 per cent during April-September this fiscal year, increasing from over 22 billion dollars in the corresponding period of 2025-26 to around 32 billion dollars. While smartphones continued to account for the largest share of the electronics export basket, non-smartphone electronics recorded significantly faster growth, reflecting the broadening and diversification of India’s electronics exports across components, printed circuit boards, communication equipment, memory products and storage devices.Exports of smartphones increased by over 35 per cent, from 13 billion dollars in April-September last year to over 18 billion dollars during April-September this year. Smartphones continued to be the largest component of India’s electronic goods exports. However, their share in total electronic goods exports moderated from 60.3 per cent to 56.8 per cent, amid faster growth in other electronics segments.Non-smartphone electronics exports recorded a growth of over 56 per cent, increasing from around nine billion dollars to over 13 billion dollars during the period. The share of non-smartphone electronics in total electronic goods exports increased from 39.7 per cent to 43.2 per cent, indicating a broadening of India’s electronics export basket.Exports of parts and accessories comprising mounted printed circuit boards increased from over 63 million dollars to over two billion dollars registering growth of 3219 per cent. Singapore was the leading destination, with exports reaching 1.87 billion dollars, followed by China at 111.5 million dollars.

. Kuwait and Bahrain reported fresh Iranian attacks on Wednesday, amid renewed escalation in hostilities between the USA and Iran starting last week. Kuwait’s Army posted on social media around midnight that its air defences were responding to hostile drone attacks. In a statement posted on X, the army said that any sounds of explosions that may be heard were from the interception of hostile drones. Iran had reportedly targeted Ali Al Salem base in Kuwait.Bahrain’s Ministry of Interior issued two alerts of potential threats early this morning before subsequently posting all-clear alerts on both threats. Meanwhile, the Bahraini Defence Force announced that Iran continues its systematic hostile approach through its criminal attacks targeting the Kingdom of Bahrain.On Tuesday, the Bahraini Defence Forces had informed of intercepting several treacherous Iranian aerial attacks. IRGC had reportedly launched drones at a US military radar system at Sheikh Isa Air Base in Bahrain on Tuesday, in response to alleged violations of Iranian airspace by US military drones. Bahrain has faced a string of Iranian attacks since Friday after almost a 2 month lull in Iranian attacks on US military assets in the Gulf region.The Iranian state media has reported US strikes on several locations on Qeshm island in the Strait of Hormuz. While Iranians have said no damage was caused to residential, commercial or infrastructure facilities, there are reports that Americans had struck Iranian missile launch sites on the island.Meanwhile, Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi has responded to reports in the US media regarding Iran’s plans for a ‘dirty bomb’ chemical weapon attack on the US. In a post on X, he called this a shameful lie and a distortion of history. He accused the US of supporting those for such attacks and said that Iran was a major victim of chemical weapons.

. Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari has called for greater adoption of biofuels and alternative fuels to make India a five trillion dollar economy and self-reliant.Addressing the 14th CII Bioenergy Summit in New Delhi, Mr Gadkari said India has the potential to harness alternative fuels and bioenergy and stressed the need for sustained efforts in this direction to achieve energy security and economic self-reliance. He emphasised that domestically produced biofuels are cheaper than conventional fossil fuels and offer economic as well as environmental benefits.Mr Gadkari further said that around three thousand plants are being set up under the GOBARdhan Yojana, of which 250 have already become operational, while nearly 200 are under development. The Minister added that effective utilisation of agricultural stubble for bioenergy could help prevent stubble burning and significantly reduce air pollution in Delhi. He also highlighted India’s potential in producing Sustainable Aviation Fuel from ethanol and rectified spirit. Mr Gadkari said that discussions are underway globally on making a two per cent biofuel blend mandatory in Sustainable Aviation Fuel.

. Most Asian stock market indices ended in negative zone today. South Korea’s Kospi shed 2.6 per cent, Taiwan’s Taiex lost 2.3 per cent, Singapore’s Strait Times fell 1.4 per cent, Japan’s Nikkei 225 dropped 1.3 per cent, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng decreased one per cent and China’s Shanghai Composite declined half a per cent.In European markets, Germany’s DAX skidded 0.8 per cent while, London’s FTSE 100 slipped 0.7 per cent, when reports last came in.

. In Badminton, the Indian Men’s Doubles pair of Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty advanced to the second round of Hong Kong Super 500 tournament today. The star Indian pair defeated Chinese Taipei’s Lee Jhe-huei and Yang Po-han, 15-21, 21-17, 28-26 in their opening round match.Earlier in the day, Indian mixed doubles pair of Dhruv Kapila and Radhika Sharma progressed to the main draw of the tounramnet with a straight-game win. They took just 36 minutes to beat Hong Kong’s Cheng Ying Kit and Leung Yuet Yee, 21-17 21-17.Indian Shuttlers Lakshya Sen and Kidambi Srikanth will begin their campaign in Men’s Singles tomorrow.

. A Delhi Court today directed the framing of charges against 14 accused, including three subject experts, in the NEET-UG 2026 question paper leak case investigated by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI).The Rouse Avenue Court also directed that charges be framed for offences under the Copyright Act, with the formal framing of charges scheduled for November 21. Special CBI Judge Ajay Gupta passed the directions and ordered that all 14 accused be physically produced before the court on Saturday, November 21, for the formal framing of charges.The court further directed that the recording of prosecution evidence commence on November 25 and continue on a day-to-day basis. The CBI registered the case in May 2026 to investigate the alleged leak of the NEET-UG 2026 examination question paper. The agency filed its main charge sheet against 13 accused in July, followed by a supplementary charge sheet against the 14th accused, Sheshrao Bajrang Suryavanshi, on September 2.

. In Mizoram, three-day Leitlangpui Music Festival is underway in south Mizoram’s Lunglei town, bringing together established musicians, emerging bands and local entrepreneurs to showcase the state’s musical heritage and promote tourism. Organised by the Ministry of Tourism and Mizoram Tourism department, the festival began yesterday at Lena Stadium at Serkawn under the theme “Music Comes Home to Serkawn”. The festival seeks to connect that legacy with contemporary musicians and emerging talent.Addressing the inaugural ceremony, Tourism Minister Lalnghinglova Hmar said music was an inseparable part of Mizoram’s cultural identity and Serkawn held a special place in the state’s musical history. The minister said that the government aimed to take Mizoram’s music and cultural heritage to national and international audiences while creating opportunities for young artists, entrepreneurs and local communities. The festival features performances by established and emerging Mizo musicians.The second day includes a band competition with 10 finalists from Aizawl, Lunglei, Nagaland and Assam, while winners of the previous two editions, Swordtune and Knot, are also scheduled to perform. The final day will feature performances by several Mizo artists and bands, followed by the minister’s address and a fireworks display.

. Talismanic former India captain Mahendra Singh Dhoni’s playing career in the IPL ended today after he was appointed the mentor of his franchise Chennai Super Kings. Team co-owner Rupa Gurunath revealed that MS Dhoni expressed his desire to retire during a call to decide retained players for the upcoming season. She said, Dhoni will continue to be a part of the CSK family as a mentor. She added that with many youngsters in the squad, his guidance will help shape the next generation of CSK. The superstar wicketkeeper-batter had announced retirement from international cricket in 2020.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi returned to New Delhi after successfully concluding his two-day visit to Manila, the Philippines. During the visit, Mr Modi participated in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit, the 21st East Asia Summit and the Quad Leaders’ Meeting. Prime Minister also visited the historic Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila and took part in the ceremony marking the commencement of its redevelopment.Mr Modi also met Philippine President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., and the two leaders discussed ways to strengthen bilateral cooperation in defence, security, trade and investment. The prime minister also discussed regional and global issues of mutual interest with his counterparts from Singapore and Thailand on the sidelines of the visit.At the annual ASEAN-India summit, the prime minister proposed nine initiatives, including a long-term maritime plan to boost connectivity and ensure seafarers’ security, free e-visas for tourists from the bloc’s member nations, cooperation on mining and critical minerals, and a framework for technical exchanges in the civil nuclear energy sector.In his remarks, Modi underlined the importance New Delhi attaches to its comprehensive strategic partnership with ASEAN and affirmed the two sides should work for peace, stability and predictability in the region and beyond.At the Quad Summit, Mr Modi said for India, the Quad is a “constructive and trusted” partnership that strives to deliver trusted solutions across the Indo-Pacific, spanning maritime security, supply chains, new technologies, and disaster response.The Quad is a strategic grouping of India, the US, Japan and Australia that works to promote a free, open and inclusive Indo-Pacific through cooperation on maritime security, technology, infrastructure and regional stability.During his address at the 21st East Asia Summit (EAS), Mr Modi announced the launch of a seafarers’ safety initiative to boost joint training and emergency response among EAS nations, emphasising that safeguarding maritime security and freedom of navigation is essential to protecting the seas as a lifeline of shared prosperity.ASEAN is a regional grouping comprising 11 Southeast Asian countries — Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, Brunei, Vietnam, Laos, Myanmar, Cambodia and Timor-Leste. India, along with the US, China, Japan and Australia, is among its dialogue partners.

. Three major works of India’s literary and intellectual heritage including Kalhana’s Rajatarangini, the Mahabharata and Kautilya’s Arthashastra have been included in UNESCO’s Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia and the Pacific. The decision was taken at the 11th session of the register held in Jakarta, Indonesia. With this recognition, India’s total number of inscriptions in the regional register has risen to six. The three works represent different aspects of India’s knowledge traditions. Rajatarangini is a historical account of Kashmir, the Mahabharata explores Dharma, duty and human values, while Arthashastra deals with governance, diplomacy and statecraft. This recognition is a matter of pride for India’s civilisational continuity, its rich knowledge traditions and its contribution to the world. The development was announced by Member Secretary, Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA),  Dr. Sachchidanand Joshi which played an important role in preparing the nomination dossiers for all three works.

. In Nepal, the Centre for Social Innovation and Foreign Policy (CESIF) today organised an event on contemporary Nepal-India relations. Experts in Kathmandu have called for stronger economic cooperation, improved connectivity and closer coordination between the two countries. The discussions also underlined the need for timely implementation of existing agreements, improved trade facilitation and market access, and stronger investment flows. Digital payments, banking integration, cross-border roaming services and climate cooperation were also identified as important areas for future collaboration.The event brought together policymakers, diplomats, security experts, academics and representatives of the media.—-Welcoming the participants, CESIF Executive Chairperson Ambassador Vijay Kant Karna highlighted energy, trade, investment, connectivity and disaster response as key areas for strengthening bilateral cooperation.Former Indian Chief of Defence Staff General Anil Chauhan described India-Nepal ties as unique, based on longstanding civilisational, cultural and people-to-people connections. He stressed that the relationship should be guided by equality, mutual respect and sensitivity towards Nepal’s identity and sovereignty.Former Indian Ambassador to Nepal Ranjit Rae said the proposed visit of the Nepalese Prime Minister would provide an opportunity for direct engagement and help strengthen mutual trust. He also emphasised cooperation in climate change and disaster response.Former Vice Chairperson of Nepal’s National Planning Commission, Dr. Govind Raj Pokharel, called for greater cooperation in hydropower, cross-border electricity trade, agriculture and connectivity. He also stressed the need to encourage private investment and move forward with pending projects.Other speakers included Ajaya Bhadra Khanal, former Chief Advisor to Interim Prime Minister Sushila Karki;  Purushottam Ojha, former Secretary of the Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies; retired Major General Binoj Basnyat; Arpita Nepal, Co-founder of Samriddhi Foundation;and Anurag Acharya.

. The 45th Indian International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026 will begin tomorrow at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi. Talking to media, Chairman of India Trade Promotion Organisation, Jawed Ashraf said that this year the focus is on three key aspects that are enhancing the visitor experience, showcasing innovations and highlighting India’s rich heritage. He said that visitors can book tickets online through the IITF 2026 mobile application, which is integrated with the DMRC’s Sarthi app. Mr Ashraf informed that shuttle bus services will operate from several metro stations, including Mandi House, connecting visitors to all entry gates of the venue. Visitors can also reach Bharat Mandapam through app-based taxis, private vehicles and public transport. He added that parking facilities for around three thousand vehicles have been arranged, along with designated waiting areas for app-based taxis. Special facilities, including wheelchair assistance will also be available for senior citizens to ensure a comfortable and convenient experience.

. In Men’s Cricket, India defeated Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final to clinch the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup title in Muscat, Oman, today. Lower-order batters Manal Chauhan and Mohit Ulva played sensational knocks to help India snatch victory from the jaws of defeat and successfully chase down a challenging target of 338 runs. Needing three runs off the final delivery, Mohit Ulva struck a boundary to seal India’s record-extending ninth title. Mohit remained unbeaten on 49 off just 26 deliveries, while Manal Chauhan contributed a valuable 47 off 32 balls. Skipper Lakshya Raichandani also played a crucial role with a brilliant 80-run knock. Mohit Ulva was named player of the match, while Aaryavir Sehwag was awarded player of the tournament.Earlier, opting to bat first, Pakistan posted 337 for 9 in their allotted 50 overs. Their innings was powered by a century from Usman Khan and half-centuries from Abdul Qadir and Farhan Yousaf. For India, Kavya Patel led India’s bowling attack, claiming four wickets.President Droupadi Murmu congratulated Team India on winning the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup. In a social media post, the President lauded the young champions for displaying exceptional skill, determination, and composure throughout the closely contested final match.Prime Minister Narendra Modi  has also congratulated the young cricketers. In a social media post, Mr Modi said that today is an outstanding day for Indian cricket. He said that their success will inspire several youngsters.Congratulating young cricketers, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said that the determination, firm resolve, and excellent sportsmanship they demonstrated on the pitch were a masterclass in India’s cricketing excellence.

. Global crude oil prices rose today. Brent crude was trading 0.3 per cent up at 92 US dollars and 73 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading half a per cent up at 86 US dollars and 12 cents per barrel, when reports last came in.

. The Quad leaders have announced a series of initiatives to strengthen maritime security, artificial intelligence cooperation, cybersecurity and critical infrastructure connectivity across the Indo-Pacific at the Manila Summit in the Philippines. The summit brought together Prime Minister Narendra Modi, US President Donald Trump, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, and Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.In a joint press release, the four leaders reaffirmed their commitment to a free, open, safe and prosperous Indo-Pacific, describing the Quad as a “partnership of action” dedicated to peace, stability and prosperity. The meeting also marked nearly a decade since the revival of the Quad and the 10th anniversary of the vision of a Free and Open Indo-Pacific, first articulated by the late Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in 2016. The leaders strongly opposed destabilising or unilateral actions aimed at changing the status quo through force or coercion, saying such actions escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and stability.They also expressed grave concern over economic coercion, including arbitrary export restrictions. Emphasising the importance of resilient supply chains, freedom of navigation and overflight, and the use of emerging technologies, the leaders committed to working together to ensure open, safe and resilient maritime transit corridors across the Indo-Pacific.The four countries announced the inaugural Quad Business Leaders’ Forum, scheduled to be held in early 2027. The forum will bring together business leaders, government officials and policy experts from the four countries to strengthen private-sector engagement, promote commercial deals and develop partnerships that contribute to the prosperity of the Indo-Pacific.

. Odisha has stepped up its disaster preparedness, particularly in Malkangiri and other southern districts, due to the approaching Cyclone Akvan over the Bay of Bengal. The Special Relief Commissioner directed the Collectors of six vulnerable districts – Ganjam, Gajapati, Rayagada, Kandhamal, Malkangiri and Koraput – to coordinate the identification and mapping of landslide-prone villages, habitations and road stretches. They were asked to verify vulnerable locations on the ground and take precautionary measures, including evacuation where necessary.The IMD, in its latest bulletin, has forecast that the system will intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm and cross the Andhra Pradesh coast on Friday. Odisha is likely to experience heavy rainfall and strong winds in southern districts. The state has deployed 74 rescue teams, including ODRAF and NDRF personnel, and identified over two lakh people for possible evacuation.

. In Football, India clinched a record-extending 10th SAFF Championship title, beating arch-rivals Pakistan 2-1 in a thrilling final to retain their crown at the National Stadium in Dhaka last night.The Blue Tigers also made history by winning the tournament for the third consecutive time. For India, Suhail Ahmad Bhat in 60th and Sandip Mandi in 88th minute scored goals. India had booked their place in the final after defeating Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final on Saturday.Union Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya has congratulated the Indian men’s football team for winning a historic hat-trick of SAFF Championship titles in Dhaka. Congratulating the team on social media, Dr. Mandaviya hailed the achievement and praised the players for completing a hat-trick of consecutive titles.

. Security Forces have neutralised Lashkar-e-Taiba’s (LeT) last known active local terrorist in the valley Lateef Bhat, during an operation in Kulgam in early morning hours today.In a social media post, Union Home Minister Amit Shah informed that the terrorist was neutralised with the coordinated efforts of Jammu and Kashmir Police , Indian Army, CRPF and intelligence agencies. Mr Shah added that one of his terrorist associates, Umar Nisar, was also neutralised in Kulgam, the day before.Mr Shah highlighted that the entire operation was marked by a very high level of synergy and the Nation salutes the brave Jawans of JKP, Army and CRPF and intelligence agencies.

. In Men’s Cricket, India defeated Pakistan by one wicket in a thrilling final to clinch the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup title in Muscat, Oman, yesterday. Lower-order batters Manal Chauhan and Mohit Ulva played sensational knocks to help India snatch victory from the jaws of defeat and successfully chase down a challenging target of 338 runs.Needing three runs off the final delivery, Mohit Ulva struck a boundary to seal India’s record-extending ninth title. Mohit remained unbeaten on 49 off just 26 deliveries, while Manal Chauhan contributed a valuable 47 off 32 balls. Skipper Lakshya Raichandani also played a crucial role with a brilliant 80-run knock. Mohit Ulva was named Player of the Match, while Aaryavir Sehwag was awarded Player of the Tournament.Earlier, opting to bat first, Pakistan posted 337 for 9 in their allotted 50 overs. Their innings was powered by a century from Usman Khan and half-centuries from Abdul Qadir and Farhan Yousaf. For India, Kavya Patel led the bowling attack, claiming four wickets.Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah have congratulated the Indian team on its victory in the Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup 2026.

. India’s overall unemployment rate declined by 0.3 per cent to 4.9 per cent in October on an annual basis. According to the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation’s periodic labour force survey bulletin, the rural unemployment rate fell to 4.2 per cent and urban unemployment rate decreased to 6.7 per cent last month. Worker Population Ratio (WPR) increased by half a per cent to 53 per cent in October on an annual basis. WPR in rural areas increased to 58.4 per cent last month, while in urban areas it remained unchanged at 50.5 per cent on a year-on-year basis. Among female, WPR rose to 33.3 per cent in October. Meanwhile, the male WPR remained largely unchanged at 73.7 per cent over the same period.The overall Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR) among persons of age 15 years and above grew by 0.3 per cent to 55.7 per cent last month on an annual basis.

. Under the theme ‘Vikas Aur Virasat’ (Development and Heritage), women-led Self-Help Groups (SHGs) from Tripura, along with various wings under the Department of Industries and Commerce, are participating in the international trade fair being held in New Delhi.At the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026, the Tripura Pavilion is showcasing a wide range of products manufactured by the state’s Self-Help Groups, along with an impressive collection of bamboo and cane handicrafts.Tripura Industries and Commerce Minister Santana Chakma visited the state’s stalls and encouraged the women entrepreneurs, appreciating their efforts. She said their contribution is significant in strengthening Tripura’s economy. She further stated that participation in such fairs would help promote products manufactured in Tripura and increase their recognition in the global market.It may be mentioned that Union Minister for Commerce and Industry Piyush Goyal inaugurated the fair on November 13. The exhibition will continue until November 27, with participation from representatives of more than 30 states and Union Territories across the country.

. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecast heavy rainfall over Tamil Nadu, Puducherry, Karaikal, and Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow.The Met Department has also predicted thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds over Kerala, Mahe and Lakshadweep during the next two days. Similar conditions are expected over Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, and Tripura tomorrow.Meanwhile, the weather agency has forecast mist and shallow fog at most places of Delhi during the morning hours tomorrow.The air quality in Delhi-NCR is in the ‘ Very Poor’ category. According to the Central Pollution Control Board, Delhi’s Air Quality Index was recorded at 303 as of 7 PM today.

. Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Dr Virendra Kumar today inaugurated the Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, INA in New Delhi this evening. The Mela will provide a dedicated marketing platform to artisans and beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Safai Karamcharis and persons with disabilities to showcase and market their products to a wider audience. Speaking on the occassion, Dr Kumar said the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has been organising Shilp Samagam Melas since 2022 and more than 1,000 artisans from Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes and Safai Karamcharis have benefited from opportunities to exhibit and market their products.  The Minister said that with approximately 150 stalls for participating male and female artisans to showcase their handicraft and handloom products under Bharat TULIP and Purple Fest, the initiative brings traditional artisans, creative talent and persons with disabilities together on a common platform to encourage wider market access and equal opportunities for participation.  The Mela will remain open to visitors until 15th of this month.

. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 45 paise to close at 93.48 rupees against the US dollar.The dollar index, which indicates US dollar’s strength against a basket of six other leading currencies, was trading at 103.60 in intra-day trade.

. The International Cricket Council (ICC) Board has approved the windows for major men’s events until 2035, confirming that India will host the 2029 Champions Trophy and co-host the 2031 ODI World Cup with Bangladesh.The 2029 Champions Trophy will be held in India from 9th to 28th of October, while the 2031 ODI World Cup will take place from 9th October to 23rd November, jointly hosted by India and Bangladesh.The ICC also announced the dates for tournaments beyond 2031, although the host nations are yet to be confirmed. The schedule covers major events from the 2028 T20 World Cup in Australia and New Zealand to the 2035 ODI World Cup.The 2028 T20 World Cup will run from October 12 to  November 12. The next edition will be held in 2030, with England, Scotland and Ireland jointly hosting the tournament. The 2032 and 2034 editions are also scheduled, but their venues are yet to be announced.Meanwhile, the World Test Championship (WTC) Final will continue to be held every two years in June until 2035. England will host the 2029 and 2031 finals, while the hosts for the 2033 and 2035 editions are yet to be decided.

. Youth Affairs and Sports Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya and Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy today unveiled the logo and mascot for the 8th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games. The Games will be held across six cities in Telangana from 11th to 22nd of next month.Addressing the gathering, Dr Mandaviya said Prime Minister Narendra Modi has placed special emphasis on connecting the youth with sports and making sports an integral part of the country’s development vision. He said various sporting events, including the Khelo India Youth Games, Khelo India Beach Games, Winter Games and Tribal Games, are being organised under the Khelo India initiative to encourage greater participation of young people in sports.Speaking on the occasion, Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy said events such as the Khelo India Youth Games would help advance the Prime Minister’s vision of a Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat by encouraging young people to stay away from substance abuse and other social challenges.Both Dr Mandaviya and Mr Reddy expressed their gratitude to Prime Minister Narendra Modi for his guidance and support in organising the Khelo India Youth Games in Telangana.The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports said around eight thousand athletes and participants are expected to take part in the Games. The 8th edition will feature 29 disciplines, including 27 competitive sports and two demonstration events.

The Cambridge Dictionary has picked ‘human’ as its Word of the Year for 2026, arguing that a year of Artificial Intelligence (AI) appearing in almost all walks of life, business, sports, and entertainment has led people to value human creativity, connection and authenticity afresh. The dictionary defines the adjective as “relating to people, as opposed to animals, machines, or gods.”In a blog, Cambridge Dictionary noted that the word increasingly appears in compounds such as “human-written,” “human-generated” and “human-made,” which now signal that something was created by people rather than AI. Four other words made the 2026 shortlist, besides the word ‘human’, the blog said. They include “analogue,” which now also covers screen-free activities like knitting, reading a book, or listening to vinyl records, and “agent,” an AI system that can operate in a complicated way without human control. Other words in shortlist were “wholesome” and “chic”.

Bangladesh witnessed fresh political tensions, labour unrest and widespread arson attacks, with at least two people killed in separate incidents and several vehicles and buildings torched across the country.Former state minister and four-time MP Mohammad Nazrul Islam Hiru was detained from Dhaka’s Baridhara DOHS. Police also arrested 26 Awami League leaders and activists in Savar, Ashulia and Dhamrai.Meanwhile, garment workers demanding higher wages clashed with police in Gazipur, blocked the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway and set a police vehicle on fire. At least 30 factories reportedly declared a general holiday.Crude bomb explosions were also reported in Dhaka and Rajshahi. Police stations, buses and political leaders’ residences were among properties targeted in attacks in several districts, raising fresh concerns over law and order.

. Indian Railways has geared up to manage the ongoing festive season rush of Diwali and Chhath Puja, with extensive crowd management preparations underway at several railway stations. Ministry of Railways said that Indian Railways is developing dedicated passenger holding areas, known as Yatri Suvidha Kendras, at major railway stations across the country. This is being done to streamline passenger movement and ease congestion during periods of heavy footfall, including the festive season. The Yatri Suvidha Kendras, or Passenger Holding Areas, are being developed to provide dedicated space for unticketed and waiting passengers. Our correspondent reports that the facilities have been designed to ensure orderly passenger movement and provide a comfortable waiting environment.The holding areas have been designed to accommodate passengers before they proceed to the platform area. Talking to Akashvani News, Northern Railway CPRO  said that at New Delhi Railway station, a holding area is available for both reserved and unreserved classes. He said additional RPF personnel have also been deployed at Railway stations to facilitate passengers.At Anand Vihar Terminal, the Yatri Suvidha Kendra has 14 ticket counters, 16 CCTV cameras, four electronic display boards and seating for 20 passengers. The facility also has separate toilet facilities for male and female passengers, a Divyangjan toilet, an RO plant, 11 HVLS fans and a public announcement system. The aim is to reduce congestion on platforms, in circulating areas and at station approaches by providing designated spaces for waiting and ticketing.

. The two day Departmental Summit titled Samaveshi Niti Sankalp, organised by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, has begun today in New Delhi. The Summit will bring together senior officials and representatives of States and Union Territories to discuss key policy priorities and strengthen the implementation of welfare programmes.It will focus on advancing the vision of Viksit Bharat@2047 through stronger Centre-State coordination and inclusive development. The Ministry said that the two-day Summit will deliberate on four key themes, including strategies for a drug-free India, accessible scholarships through the One Nation, One Scholarship Portal, early intervention to reduce the burden of disabilities and Sugamya Bharat for developed India.

. ASEAN leaders have adopted a new declaration aimed at promoting artificial intelligence (AI) -powered growth among micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), across the region. The initiative focuses on making AI technology more affordable and accessible to smaller businesses by strengthening digital infrastructure, improving AI literacy and promoting the responsible use of emerging technologies. The ASEAN Leaders’ Declaration on AI-Powered MSME Growth was adopted during the 49th ASEAN Summit which began on 15th of this month at Manila in  the Philippines under the country’s 2026 chairmanship theme: “Navigating Our Future, Together.”The declaration outlines a coordinated regional framework to address the challenges faced by smaller businesses in adopting artificial intelligence and accessing new technologies. ASEAN leaders recognise that MSMEs are the backbone of the region’s economies. However, many continue to face barriers to AI adoption, including limited awareness, inadequate data readiness, a lack of digital skills, high technology costs and uneven digital infrastructure.ASEAN leaders have called for stronger public-private partnerships to provide affordable AI tools, cloud services and training programmes for small businesses. They have also stressed the importance of AI awareness, data protection, cybersecurity and inclusive access, particularly for women-led businesses and enterprises in rural and remote areas.The Philippines, as the lead proponent of the initiative, will coordinate with other ASEAN member states and the ASEAN Secretariat to monitor progress under the AI-Powered MSME Growth Action Plan.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi today highlighted the growing partnership between India and ASEAN and called for greater cooperation to ensure peace, stability and prosperity in the Indo-Pacific region. He was addressing the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit in Manila, Philippines.Addressing the summit, Prime Minister Modi congratulated Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on his successful chairship of ASEAN and his important contribution as country coordinator for India.He said that this was his 13th interaction with ASEAN leaders in this format and said India’s Act East policy had given India-ASEAN relations new momentum and depth over the past several years.Highlighting the expansion of bilateral cooperation, PM Modi said the partnership, built on shared culture and heritage, was now expanding into new areas such as digital technologies, defence and space.He further stated that since 2014, India and ASEAN had undertaken more than 100 initiatives to strengthen people-to-people ties. More than 250 quick-impact projects had been launched, while over 10,000 scholarships had been provided for skill development.The Prime Minister also highlighted that direct flights between India and nine ASEAN countries, along with growing tourism, reflected the close ties between the two sides.Referring to the global situation, PM Modi observed that the world had faced one crisis after another over the past few years, making peace, stability and predictability increasingly important.He said the summit’s theme, “Navigating Our Future Together,” held particular significance in the current global context. He emphasised that India and ASEAN together represented about one-fourth of the world’s population and that their future should be shaped through cooperation rather than competition.He added that India and ASEAN possessed the capabilities and shared resolve to make the region a symbol of peace and stability.PM Modi also noted that this was his third visit to an ASEAN country this year, reflecting the special importance ASEAN held for India.He said India’s development and ASEAN’s prosperity were closely interconnected, adding that the ASEAN Community Vision 2045 and India’s vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047 could play an important role in achieving shared aspirations.The Prime Minister observed that over the past twelve years, India and ASEAN had given their partnership fresh momentum and stressed the need to work together to chart a new course for the future of the region.Reaffirming India’s commitment, PM Modi said the country’s support for ASEAN unity and ASEAN centrality would remain unwavering.Expressing confidence in the outcome of the summit, he said the meeting would elevate the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership to new heights and contribute to building a secure, inclusive and prosperous Indo-Pacific.Earlier, PM Modi visited the Khalsa Diwan Gurudwara in Manila and led the foundation-stone laying ceremony for its redevelopment in the presence of the Panch Pyare.

. Akashvani will broadcast the recording of the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, delivered by Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, tonight at 9:30 PM. The recording will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani network on the occasion of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s birth anniversary.Delivering the 67th Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, Mr Chouhan said that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s vision, determination and leadership laid the foundation for India’s national unity and territorial integrity. He said that Sardar Patel’s efforts to integrate 565 princely states remain a defining chapter in the country’s history. The Minister emphasised that Patel’s vision of a united India continues to inspire the nation through the spirit of ‘Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat’.Mr Chouhan also said that, inspired by Sardar Patel’s firm approach towards national security and his policy of zero tolerance towards terrorism, India has responded decisively to threats from across its borders, including through measures such as surgical strikes.As a tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who served as independent India’s first Deputy Prime Minister and Information and Broadcasting Minister, Akashvani has been organising the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture since 1955. Over the years, the annual event has served as a rich repository of thoughts, ideas and perspectives on a wide range of subjects. It has also provided an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of India’s diverse cultural heritage and the various dimensions of its developmental challenges.

. Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), Chairman, Vivek Chaturvedi today inaugurated the GST and Customs Pavilion at the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) in New Delhi. Talking to the media, Mr Chaturvedi has said that the Customs Pavilion is largely focused on providing information about initiatives such as GST and Customs, which are recently undertaken by the government. He noted that the pavilion provides insights in relation to GST processes and the rate rationalisation exercise. The Chairman highlighted that dedicated helpdesks have also been set up to provide on-the-spot assistance to visitors on GST, Customs and related services.Finance Ministry said that the Pavilion is showcasing Next-Gen GST process reforms, updated Baggage Rules, 2026 and digital initiatives of CBIC.  It also highlighted that the dedicated helpdesks will provide a single-point interface for public assistance and facilitates direct interaction between the Department and citizens. To make awareness more interactive and engaging, the Pavilion features a range of innovative educational and entertainment activities for visitors across age groups.The Pavilion is also showcasing the Department’s digital transformation initiatives while highlighting the role of technology in promoting transparency, efficiency and ease of compliance

. India’s Wholesale Price Index (WPI) based inflation rose to 12.29 per cent in October on an annual basis, from 11.39 per cent in September. According to the provisional data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, crude petroleum and natural gas, mineral oils, basic metals, chemicals and chemical products were among the key drivers of wholesale price inflation during the month.Among the major categories in WPI, year-on-year inflation in the Fuel and Power surged sharply to 32.84 per cent last month. Inflation in Primary Articles rose to 9.24 per cent, from 8.67 per cent in September, while inflation in Manufactured Products eased marginally to 9.54 per cent during the same period. However, the WPI Food Index, which comprises food articles and food products, dipped marginally to 8.58 per cent last month, from 8.66 per cent September. Meanwhile, the Output Producer Price Index grew by 12.06 per cent year-on-year in October. According to the data, cumulative WPI inflation for April to October period stood at 10.14 per cent, compared with a contraction of 0.3 per cent during the corresponding period of the previous financial year.

Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman today chaired the second Pre-Budget Consultation meeting with experts from agriculture and rural development sectors ahead of the forthcoming General Budget 2027-28 in New Delhi. The Pre-Budget consultation meeting was also attended by Secretaries of Department of Economic Affairs, Anuradha Thakur, Secretary of Department of Fisheries, Dr. Abhilaksh Likhi and senior officials of Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.Earlier in the day, the Finance Minister chaired the first Pre-Budget Consultation with leading economists in connection with the upcoming Union Budget 2027-28, in New Delhi. The meeting was also attended by Secretary, Department of Economic Affairs, Anuradha Thakur and Chief Economic Adviser, Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran and senior officers from the Department.The Finance Ministry conducts several pre-Budget consultation meetings annually with experts, industry leaders, economists, and state officials. The deliberations seek to ensure the Union budget reflects diverse perspectives and addresses key economic priorities.

The Ministry of Health and Family Welfare’s dedicated Health Pavilion at the 45th India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2026 in New Delhi is showcasing its flagship health programmes and public healthcare initiatives. The theme of this year’s Health Pavilion is Yuva Bharat, Swasth Bharat, highlights preventive healthcare, healthy lifestyles and youth participation in building a healthier nation. The Pavilion was inaugurated by NITI Aayog Member, Dr M Srinivas, in the presence of Health Secretary, Punya Salila Srivastava.Addressing the gathering, Dr. Srinivas emphasised on preventive healthcare and healthy lifestyle choices to address rising burden of Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs) and lifestyle-related health conditions. He also highlighted the importance of public awareness, early detection and timely medical intervention in preventing and managing NCDs. Outlining the benefits of Health Pavilion, Dr. Srinivas said that it offers a valuable opportunity for citizens to learn about common health risks, understand preventive measures and familiarise themselves with various Government healthcare programmes and services. He also encouraged visitors to actively participate in the Pavilion’s activities and use the opportunity to enhance their understanding of health and well-being.The Ministry noted that in the Pavilion 39 stalls representing 24 national health programmes and organisations showcase Government’s healthcare initiatives, achievements and services. The Ministry also highlighted that a dedicated TB stall has been established to raise awareness about tuberculosis and TB screening is being conducted using AI-enabled handheld X-ray technology. The Pavilion also included interactive activities, live cpr demonstrations, health awareness sessions and dedicated kids’ zone to engage visitors and promote healthy living. The Ministry said that the Pavilion provides an important platform to connect directly with citizens, showcase the Government’s wide-ranging healthcare initiatives and promote greater public awareness about preventive healthcare, early diagnosis and healthier lifestyles.

. The Indian Navy is celebrating the Golden Jubilee of its Long-Range Maritime Reconnaissance (LRMR) operations today. The occasion commemorates five decades of airborne vigil in support of India’s maritime security. The milestone coincides with the 50th anniversary of the commissioning of Indian Naval Air Squadron (INAS) 312, known as the Albatross.The Squadron Albatross was commissioned on this day in the year 1976 at INS Hansa in Goa. Defence Ministry said that it began operations with five Lockheed Super Constellation aircraft transferred from the Indian Air Force. The Navy’s long-range reconnaissance aircraft have played an important role in several operations. These include Operations Cactus, Vijay, Parakram and Sindoor. They have also been deployed in anti-piracy operations and search and rescue missions.The Ministry noted that the Golden Jubilee honours generations of naval pilots, mission crews, maintenance staff and support personnel. Their dedication and professionalism have helped the Navy build and maintain this important capability over the past five decades.

. In Football, defending champions India will take on Pakistan in the final of the SAFF Championship at the National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh, today. India will be aiming to secure their 10th overall SAFF Championship title and make history by winning the tournament for the third consecutive time. The Blue Tigers booked their place in the final after defeating Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final on Saturday.Pakistan, meanwhile, will be making their first-ever appearance in a SAFF Championship final. The two sides have met 30 times in senior internationals, with India winning 17 matches, Pakistan four and nine ending in draws. Today’s clash will, however, be their first meeting in a senior SAFF Championship final.India are the most successful team in the tournament’s history, having won a record nine titles, and they are the favourites to lift the trophy once again.

. In Football, India clinched a record-extending 10th SAFF Championship title, beating arch-rivals Pakistan 2-1 in a thrilling final to retain their crown at the National Stadium in Dhaka tonight. The Blue Tigers also made history by winning the tournament for the third consecutive time. For India, Suhail Ahmad Bhat in 60th and Sandip Mandi in 88th minute scored goals. India had booked their place in the final after defeating Bhutan 2-1 in the semi-final on Saturday

The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has said that the Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan over central parts of South and adjoining Westcentral Bay of Bengal moved north-northwestward and lay centred this morning over the same region.Continuing to move north-northwestward, it is likely to cross North Andhra Pradesh and Yanam and South Odisha coasts between Narsapur and Puri by Friday noon as a severe cyclonic storm. The storm will have a maximum sustained wind speed of 90 to 100 kilometres per hour gusting to 110 kilometres per hour. The Met Department has advised fishermen not to venture into the southeast, southwest, west-central and northwest Bay of Bengal till Friday.The Weather Agency has issued orange colour warning for heavy rainfall over Coastal Andhra Pradesh and Odisha till 20th of this month. According to IMD, Rayalaseema, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal are likely to witness thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds till Friday. Similar conditions are expected to prevail over Andaman and Nicobar Islands during the same period.
